title: TypeError: Object of type Send is not JSON serializable when using PostgresSaver checkpoint
author: lasendo

comments.author: Balmy-afterGlow
comments.body: @lasendo You can try to upgrade your langgraph version to 5.0.0 or above. Because the memory storage location of checkpoint[pending_sends] has changed, this should be a compatibility issue.

comments.author: lasendo
comments.body:
Thank you, @Balmy-afterGlow.
I have been delaying this for a while, hoping to get a more detailed feedback on the issue.

I guess you mean v0.5.0, as the latest LangGraph version to date is the v1.0.7.

I did several attempts with the docker compose setup changing the versions of LangGraph, while not specifying any for [
langchain, langchain-community, langchain-core, langchain-experimental, langgraph-checkpoint and langgraph-sdk], i.e.

```requirements.txt
langchain 
langchain-community 
langchain-core 
langchain-experimental 
langgraph==[version] 
langgraph-checkpoint 
langgraph-checkpoint-postgres==3.0.1 
langgraph-sdk 
psycopg[binary,pool] 
psycopg==3.2.12 
psycopg-pool==3.2.7 
pydantic==2.10.2 
```

I tried for [version] 0.3.1, 0.4.0, 0.5.0, 0.5.1, 0.5.2, 0.5.3, 0.6.0, 1.0.0, 1.0.7.

I am not aware why but now the error is different even with v0.2.53 in my docker reproducible setup. The error is:
